title: Message record (durable history row)
description: I/O contract §3: "Every message Odin perceives or produces is a row in the service's `messages` table"; fields `chat` (`odin/<project>`, `mimir`, or `work/<name>`), `i` ("permanent integer id, dense from 0 within the chat"), `kind`, `src`, `text`, `size` ("bytes of `text`"; UTF-8, a semantic check, not a schema rule), `date`, `ref`. A message is not a revisioned record: it is append-only (redaction excepted, §8).
